question: Count chats per datasource name and export name with chat_count.
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(c.id) AS chat_count FROM datasources d JOIN chats c ON d.id = c.datasource_id GROUP BY d.name

question: Count records per chat title and return title with record_count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.title, COUNT(r.id) AS record_count FROM chats c JOIN chat_records r ON c.id = r.chat_id GROUP BY c.title

question: Count total records by datasource type.
gold_sql: SELECT d.type, COUNT(r.id) AS total_records FROM datasources d JOIN chats c ON d.id = c.datasource_id JOIN chat_records r ON c.id = r.chat_id GROUP BY d.type
